Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
Does the secondary effect of Dismemberment of Osiris and of Praxis Seizure: Istanbul count as targeting a Banu Haqim or including a Banu Haqim in the terms of a referendum?

Dismemberment of Osiris

Cardtype: Action
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Serpentis
[ser]  Burn a titled vampire in torpor (this is not diablerie). Each ready vampire of the same clan as the titled vampire burns 1 blood.
[SER] As above, and the titled vampire's controller burns 1 pool.
Artist: Steve Ellis

Praxis Seizure: Istanbul

Cardtype: Political Action
Title. Requires a Camarilla vampire.
Successful referendum means this card is put on this vampire to represent the unique Camarilla title of Prince of Istanbul, and if this vampire is not a Banu Haqim, lock all Banu Haqim. In this referendum, each ready Banu Haqim gets +1 vote.
Artist: Mark Tedin

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
It is chosen explicitly. "Lock all Banu Haqim". The condition is either true or false, which is evident at the time the political action is taken. So when the action is taken, it is clear whether or not it chooses and targets Banu Haqim. If the condition is true, then Yoruba Shrine could be used in my opinion.

Similar wording was ruled to be a d-action in the case of condemn the sins of the father. If a clan is chosen. then all members of the clan are chosen, and it is a d-action against all players who control any Banu Haqim simultaneously.

Although PS:I is not a directed action, Yoruba shrines wording extends the same effect to political referendums, and since the wording is the same, I dont see how it could not count as chosen. The condition does not change anything.

I am only expecting consistency with your previous rulings on similar cards.

Smoking craters tell no tales.
—Tex talks Battletech

That's why Yoruba Shrine works in that case.

But the OP is not about that card.

> I am only expecting consistency with your previous rulings on similar cards.
>
Political actions and actions are not the same, even if they look like having "similar" effects.

Messages.Author: Alanmut
Messages.Body: Okay, Yoruba says that if ONE Assamite is chosen... Osiris describes the direct action concerning the first vampire; the secondary effect, in my view, is not a direct action on other vampires of the same clan, but an effect of a successful action on the target vampire, which, if the target of the direct action is an Assamite, would allow the use of Yoruba. Regarding the effect of Praxis Istanbul, the card says that if the referendum passes, you choose a target and apply the card to them, which differs from cards like banishment where you choose a target and if the referendum passes, you resolve the effect, since the effect is directly for that vampire.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> the1andonlime wrote:
> Sorry to harp on it but I am still a little confused as to where the line is drawn
>
> Condemn the Sins of the Father says "Choose a clan. <do stuff to vampires of that clan>" and Dismemberment of Osiris says "Burn a title vampire in torpor. <do stuff to vampires of the same clan>"
> They feel to me like they are similar in targeting but you are saying no
> So I am just curious as to how to apply the logic to here (and for other similar cards)
>
Just as a recap:

For political actions (Praxis Seizure: Istanbul), the terms are defined in the sentences before "Successful referendum means...".

For actions, the target (if any) is in the first sentence or first pair of sentences in the case of "Choose X. Do Y to X."

For instance, for Dismemberment of Osiris, the only target of the action is the titled vampire in torpor (first sentence). The second sentence is a consequence of the first.

Consider

Name: Kindred Spirits
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Dementation
[dem]  Bleed any Methuselah. Gain 1 pool if the bleed is successful (for 1 or more).
[DEM] As above, with +1 bleed.

Even though you gain 1 pool, you're not the target of the action.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Warning: Spoiler!

*Edit*
Vampires in torpor are Not in Ready region, thus are Not Ready.

Warning: Spoiler!

Play Area

The area in front of each Methuselah is divided into two regions: the uncontrolled region (6), and the controlled region (7). The controlled region is further divided into two areas: the ready region (8) and the torpor region (9). Torpor is a special area for wounded vampires. As the game progresses, you will gain control of some of your minions, moving them to the ready region, face up.

Once case where Condemn cant be stopped with Shrine, is if all your Banu Haqim are in Torpor.
